verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a voice-agent API platform, for example batch outbound calls or bulk config management. The evidence pack shows no documented capability for acting on many items at once. Reusable configurations, parallel A/B testing of two configs, and a CLI that transcribes files are adjacent features, not bulk-operation support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
